prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One cohesive irregular swarm of ordinary brown/grey rats moving toward viewer, about 25 individually legible rats in foreground/middle, partly hidden smaller rat shapes suggesting more behind without uniform tiny noise. Narrow pointed snouts, round ears, long bare tails, four small feet each. Uneven tapered wedge, gaps between groups, varied natural poses, a few larger front rats, one implied shared swarm silhouette. NOT a perfect circle, NOT a pancake or solid mound, no repeated identical cutouts. Three-quarter slightly elevated view, complete swarm and tails inside margin. Broad soft fur shapes, selective face detail on nearest rats. Empty charcoal backdrop, no sewer props, victims, gore, skulls or text. Reference painting only.
